title: RiskScan
description: SAIA-Class S schema defining the predictive engine's risk scan input envelope, including actor, context, signals, wellbeing factors, and doctrinal constraints.

scanId.description: Unique identifier for this risk scan request.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the scan was initiated.

actorContext.description: Information about the actor whose behavior or action is being evaluated.

decisionContext.description: Context of the decision or action being evaluated for risk.
